{{Quote|Nothing beats gizka, though, when it comes to being a true pest. Fortunately, there is one way I like the critters, and that's thinly sliced and served hot over toasted or therm-zapped pseudograin bread.|Dex's Diner menu, on its hot gizka sandwich|<ref name="Menu" />}}
A '''hot gizka sandwich''' was a type of [[Sandwich/Legends|sandwich]] made with the meat of the [[Gizka/Legends|gizka]],<ref name="Menu" /> a small [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="Creatures of KOTOR">''{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/KOTORCreaturesFiraxa|text=Creatures of KOTOR 1: Firaxa and Gizka}}''</ref> that was considered a interstellar vermin. The [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]] consisted of thinly sliced gizka meat served hot over toasted or therm-zapped [[pseudograin bread]]. The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] served the sandwich at his [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]], [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for 7.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hot gizka sandwiches were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
